title: PersonaLink
tagline: Interact with influencer iNFTs & learn their skills via AI agents on-chain.
description:
Our project bridges the gap between everyday users and high-profile influencers or experts by using interactive NFTs (iNFTs). Users can purchase or access a particular trait or skill of an influencer, which is then delivered via an AI-powered agent. This agent simulates the influencer’s behavior, providing advice, suggestions, and personalized responses.

We integrate 0G’s iNFT standard (ERC-7857) to ensure on-chain ownership and secure trait transfer. Each influencer’s traits are stored in a smart contract on Ethereum. Users interact with these iNFT agents to learn skills or simply engage with their favorite personalities without direct contact.

By combining blockchain, AI agents powered by ASI, and a seamless web interface, we create a novel platform where knowledge and inspiration from top creators is accessible to everyone.
how_its_made:
1. Frontend: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel for a fast, responsive, client-focused experience.

2. Backend / AI Agents: Python-powered LLMs via FastAPI, integrated with ASI to simulate influencer behavior. These agents handle personalized responses and trait-based interactions, deployed on Render.

3. Blockchain / Smart Contracts: We use Ethereum with Foundry to write and test smart contracts implementing ERC-7857 (iNFT standard) for traits and ownership. Users can buy traits and store them securely on-chain.

4. Database: SQL for structured data storage, with mock data used during development and testing.

Partner Technologies:

0G Chain: Provides the iNFT standard and blockchain infrastructure.
ASI: Powers agent intelligence and personalized user interactions.

Integration Highlights:

Real-time agent interaction simulates a direct conversation with influencers.
Traits are minted as on-chain iNFTs for verifiable ownership.

The frontend communicates with both the blockchain (via Web3) and the agent backend to deliver a smooth user experience.

Hacky but notable: We implemented a dual-fetch system that combines iNFT data from the blockchain with agent personality traits dynamically, creating a live, evolving AI character.
